verdict.rationale: Factory supports delegating tasks to droids (custom droids via /droids, sessions API, task delegation) and integrates with Slack, which implies chat-based interaction, but there is no explicit documentation of an @-mention/tagging workflow inside a chat thread to discuss or delegate a bug. Missing for 10: explicit Slack/Teams @-mention or in-thread tagging mechanic, examples of discussing a bug conversationally before delegation, and confirmation that delegation can originate from within a chat thread rather than the CLI/App.
